economic_objective: Find a high-turnover Bybit-native nonlinear order-book edge whose realistic 24bp-stress account path can exceed 1% sample-day geometric growth before spending time on full official-period reconstruction.

scope_boundary.primary_decision_rule: A cost-sensitive nonlinear model directly forecasts future executable BBO return magnitude and direction from stationary full-book and event-flow features.
scope_boundary.not_the_pr68_rule_family: No liquidity-pull continuation or pull-refill failure threshold is used to select a trade. Cancellation and refill estimates are auxiliary model inputs among queue shape, multi-level OFI, microprice, spread, aggressive flow, update intensity, response efficiency, volatility and clock state.
scope_boundary.fit_partition_difference: Only 2022-07-01 labels fit the model; 2023-07-01 is untouched development. PR #68 fits hand-specified rules on March/May/July 2023 and conditionally opens later 2023 dates.

hypothesis.mechanism: A nonlinear interaction of stationary multi-level order-flow imbalance, queue geometry, spread, microprice, update intensity, aggressive flow, execution-adjusted withdrawal/refill, short-horizon response efficiency and volatility predicts the tail of future executable BBO returns better than any single imbalance or cancellation rule. Selecting only forecasts whose magnitude is extreme relative to the fit distribution may isolate moves large enough to clear 24bp all-in cost.
hypothesis.why_cost_scale_can_be_large: The screen is trained on executable bid/ask return labels, selects only the strongest multivariate forecasts, crosses the spread after explicit latency and requires the same path to remain profitable at 24bp rather than optimizing a sub-basis-point statistical score.
hypothesis.failure_condition: No candidate with at least 50 trades has positive mean and median net return at 24bp, positive account return on every development date, and positive 1%-risk daily growth after counterfactual top-winner removal.

data.provider: Tardis normalized CSV from captured Bybit public WebSocket feeds
data.conditional_expansion: Only a concentration-surviving candidate may open additional first-day samples before 2024 under the exact frozen feature/model/execution contract.

causal_state.stationary_inputs: multi-level OFI and normalized queue shape rather than raw price levels
causal_state.depletion_decomposition: bid and ask five-level depth decreases minus contemporaneous opposing aggressive trade amount
causal_state.replenishment_decomposition: five-level depth increases plus contemporaneous amount consumed by opposing aggressive trades
causal_state.features: multi-level OFI, queue shape, signed aggressive flow, withdrawal/refill at 0.5/1/3 seconds, microprice, depth imbalance, spread, response efficiency, update intensity, volatility and time of day
causal_state.future_information_prohibition: entry is one, three or five complete future 100ms bins after decision; labels are used only in the 2022 fit partition

model.loss_role: direct future executable BBO return regression; candidate gating is based on absolute forecast tail and independent event-strength tail

execution.entry: aggressive buy at current ask or aggressive sell at current bid after 100/300/500ms latency
execution.exit: the preregistered forecast horizon, or first adverse executable BBO stop touch
execution.same_signal_priority: largest absolute model forecast; deterministic chronological replay
execution.missing_or_stale_state: signal and trade path rejected; no favorable forward fill

account_replay.position_notional_to_nav: planned risk divided by stop-plus-cost fraction
account_replay.gap_loss: actual adverse BBO at first observed stop crossing
account_replay.top_winner_stress: remove the largest 10% of positive 12bp event keys before global-slot routing and rerun the account

implementation_correction_before_economi.observed_failure: pandas datetime Series requires the .dt accessor for hour/minute/second on the first real fit-day build
implementation_correction_before_economi.allowed_change: deterministic replacement of Series.hour/minute/second with Series.dt.hour/dt.minute/dt.second after verifying the immutable original evaluator bytes

prohibitions: no hand-coded PR #68 cancellation/refill trade rule
no private credentials, paper, testnet or live orders
no ranking promotion from the two-day fatal screen
